This zone lines up with the lower band and the 11-21 low, so it is a confluence area. Past reactions there do not guarantee a repeat.

**Rationale**: The bear side won this round, though not by enough to justify a full Sell.

The bull made some real points. RSI is deeply stretched (19.54 on 11-20, now 28.18). MACD downside momentum stopped accelerating after its -171.66 low. The 1506-1540 zone held repeatedly in June and again on 11-21. The macro backdrop isn't hostile: recession odds are 3%. The bull's plan was also disciplined: scale in, set an invalidation level, and add only on confirmation.

The bear took apart the core of that case, the claim that the risk is limited and the payoff is much larger:
(1) The risk/reward doesn't hold up. The stop at 1538.60 is about 8.4% below the 1679.34 close, while the first target, the VWMA at 1788.82, is only 6.5% above. That's worse than 1:1 on the first leg. The 14-26% targets sit above falling averages that tend to cap rallies in a downtrend. The 'upside priced near zero' point used the 2% odds of touching $3,500, which says nothing about the 1789-2116 targets.
(2) The crowd expects the floor to break. Prediction markets put a $1,500 touch at 57%, below the bull's stop, and those odds rose 25.6 points in a week. A $1,250 touch (-25.6%) is at 24%. The bull can't call sentiment washed out while citing a market that is still pricing in more downside.
(3) The same oversold signals already failed this month. On 11-14, RSI was 19.80 and price had closed below the lower Bollinger band, and ETH then fell another 13%. RSI has been under 30 for 13 sessions with no bullish divergence, which the bull conceded.
(4) Sellers haven't been flushed out. The June low came on about 39.9B of volume; November peaked at about 21.5B. The 11-23 spike to 1842 reversed about 8% to close at 1708.85, and 11-24 made a lower low. Buyers had their chance and didn't hold it.
(5) The bull's own add conditions aren't met: no close above 1759.56 and 1788.82, no MACD cross, no RSI above 40. Buying now is an unconfirmed bet against the trend.

Why Underweight rather than Sell: conditions this oversold produce sharp countertrend bounces, so selling everything at the low has a real cost. The 1496-1540 support hasn't broken yet. And neither side had on-chain, ETF flow, staking, fee-burn, derivatives, news or Reddit data, so the case rests on daily technicals and a thin sentiment sample (14 posts). The evidence favours cutting exposure and selling into strength, not exiting entirely.

**Strategic Actions**: 1. Target size: about 50% of a standard ETH-USD allocation.
2. Trim into strength, not weakness. Take about half of the reduction now. Rest sell orders for the other half in the 1760-1842 zone (10 EMA 1759.56, VWMA 1788.82, 11-23 spike high 1842.19). If price spikes there without a daily close above 1789, finish the trim.
